evidence.detail: The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 73 and one target-player index through the matching u16 transform.
Exact-current outbound protocol authority identifies opcode 73 as player option 3, including the alternate name-resolved route that resolves to the same transport.
S2C104 can configure arbitrary player option labels, so the transport slot is the semantic contract; no contextual verb is asserted.
The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 153 and one target-player index through the matching u16 transform.
Exact-current outbound protocol authority identifies opcode 153 as player option 2.
S2C104 can configure arbitrary player option labels, so the transport slot is the semantic contract; no contextual verb such as Follow or Trade is asserted.
